title: 艾翁·林间长光
description: 高瘦树人艾翁在宽阔林间静立，枝角、苔须与长木肢保留自然形态，单束日光切出有力的树皮轮廓。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Ivern is a very tall slender tree-like forest being with long wooden limbs, a kindly carved face, a mossy beard, leafy brows, and twisting branch growth above the head. Preserve his organic bark anatomy instead of dressing him as an ordinary human. The twig fingers are relaxed and distinct, his posture is upright, and no frightening branches, injuries, or sinister facial details appear.
art_direction.scene: Place him still in a wide forest clearing, one long hand resting lightly against a plain upright trunk and the other lowered beside his body. Keep every limb and branch silhouette legible. A single hard sunbeam penetrates the high canopy, dividing bark into angular wax-crayon planes, while sparse towering trees and a distant pale opening establish immense serene depth.
art_direction.palette: bark umber, moss green, deep teal shadow, golden light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
